armorer.summary: A stocky bearded armorer with a chainmail shirt, a leather apron with crossed straps, a round shield, and a hammer. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: All signature details are present: the curly hair, the full beard, the chainmail shirt, the crossed straps, the belt buckle, the bracers, the shield, and the hammer.
The open smile with teeth matches the mockup expression.
The chainmail, the leather, the wood, and the steel each read as a different material.
The shield and the beard make the character easy to identify in all eight sprite directions.
issues: The trousers are brown, the same value as the apron. The mockup trousers are dark olive grey. Paint the trousers dark olive grey to separate the legs from the apron.
The apron hem flares out from the waist like a ring at the back and the side. Bring the hem closer to the body.
The shield rim is thin. The mockup shows a thick steel rim. Make the rim wider and darker steel.
The boots have no leather cuffs, and the belt has no pouches. Add the ankle cuffs and the pouches at the hips.
The hair is a lumpy cap with a noisy surface. The mockup hair has clear, separate curls. Shape the hair into larger curl locks.
The walk is stiff. The shield arm and the hammer arm almost do not move.
armorer.next: Paint the trousers dark olive grey and add the boot cuffs so that the lower body matches the mockup value plan.

carpenter.summary: A young carpenter with a red headband, a blue shirt, tan overalls, a tool belt, and a saw. It is the same character as the mockup, but the saw and the hair show clear differences.
strengths: The red headband, the blue shirt, and the tan overalls match the mockup palette.
The tool belt has a hammer, a yellow ruler, and a pouch, and the belt gives detail at the waist.
The closed, friendly smile matches the mockup expression.
The headband knot with tails reads at the back of the head.
issues: The saw points down and to the front, and the front view shows the blade almost edge-on. The mockup holds the saw up and to the front. Bend the arm and turn the saw so that the blade points up and shows its flat side.
The saw blade has no teeth, and the blade shading shows faceted streaks. Add a row of teeth on one edge and make the blade surface smooth.
The hair is a tall, smooth mass on top of the head. The mockup hair has swept locks with a curl at the front and at the side. Shape the hair into separate swept locks.
The shirt has no collar, and the overall bib has no buttons. Add the collar and the two bib buttons.
The ear is small. The mockup ear is large. Make the ear larger.
The pencil in the hair is very small and does not read. Make the pencil longer and brighter.
carpenter.next: Turn the saw so that the blade points up and to the front with visible teeth, as in the mockup.

fisher.summary: A young fisher in a yellow rain hat and a yellow raincoat, with a navy knit collar, green boots, a fish, and a rod. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hair fringe and the coat lapels are missing.
strengths: The yellow hat and coat with the navy collar give a strong color plan that matches the mockup.
The wide hat and the tall rod make a silhouette that reads from every view.
The fish and the rod read in all eight sprite directions, and the face reads at 128 px.
The knit collar, the rubber boots, the metal fish, and the wood rod each read as a different material.
issues: The forehead has no hair fringe. The hair shows only at the sides as two black blocks. The mockup has a thick black fringe with tufts under the hat. Add the fringe so that it frames the face.
The coat has no lapels. Only two small collar points show. Add the large lapels from the mockup.
The coat has four buttons in two rows. The mockup has two buttons in one row. Change the coat to one row of two buttons.
The pocket flaps are only faint paint. Model the pocket flaps as raised shapes.
The fist holds the fish at its side. The mockup hand wraps around the fish body. Move the fish into the fist.
The walk is stiff. The arms with the fish and the rod almost do not move.
fisher.next: Add the black hair fringe under the hat brim so that the face matches the mockup.

gardener.summary: An old gardener with a wide hat, a white beard, a big round nose, a yellow plaid shirt, green overalls, and a green watering can. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The face reads as the mockup: white bushy brows, a big round nose, a white moustache and beard, and an open smile.
The wide hat with the green band gives a strong silhouette from every view.
The watering can and the trowel at the hip support the gardener role.
The straw, the cloth, the beard, and the painted can each read as a different material.
issues: The hat is pale straw yellow with a weave texture. The mockup hat is darker tan felt with a pinched crown. Darken the hat to tan and pinch the crown.
At 128 px the hat hides most of the face in all directions except south. Only the nose and the beard show. Make the face read better under the brim, for example with a smaller brim tilt to the back.
The plaid lines on the shirt are faint. The mockup plaid has strong dark lines. Darken the plaid lines.
The overall bib is a lighter green than the trousers and reads as a separate apron. Use one dark green for the bib and the trousers.
The watering can is small and hangs near the ground. The mockup can is larger. Make the can larger.
The ears are small. The mockup ears are large and pink. Make the ears larger.
gardener.next: Darken the hat to tan felt and pinch the crown so that the largest form matches the mockup.
